features.wire: Add "Save All" to file_menu (main.rs:668) iterating self.docs open documents and calling the controller save for each edited one.

features.feature: Word .docx / .doc / Word XML / ODT / web archive

features.wire: Start with .docx and .odt (zip + XML): new docx.rs/odt.rs mapping paragraphs, runs (b/i/u, font, size, colour) and alignment to text.rs cells; add types in document.rs read/write.

features.wire: Add an encoding popup to the open/save panels via SDK panel accessory (or a Format > Text Encoding submenu); decode/encode UTF-16/Latin-1/MacRoman in document.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: File > Export as PDF…
features.note: print.rs already renders PDF for printing; no Export as PDF menu item.
features.wire: Add File > Export as PDF… in file_menu (main.rs:668) that runs print.rs PDF generation and writes it through ctx.save_document with public.pdf.

features.note: Print, paper size and orientation exist; no header/footer or rewrap options.
features.wire: Add Header and Footer (title, page n of m) and Rewrap toggles to the print path in print.rs and as checked items under the Print submenu.

features.feature: Show/Hide document properties (author, title, subject, keywords, copyright)

features.note: RTF reader skips the info group (rtf.rs:6).

features.feature: Delete / Complete / Insert (page break, line break, paragraph break)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Delete, Complete, Insert submenu
features.wire: Add Insert submenu items inserting break characters via insert_raw (main.rs:470); Complete = word completion from the document vocabulary.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Attach Files…, Link…
features.wire: Add a link attribute on cells in text.rs written as RTF \field HYPERLINK; Edit > Link… sheet; open via ctx.open_url on Cmd-click.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Find submenu

features.wire: Add both to the Find group in edit_menu: Cmd+E copies the selection into self.find; Cmd+J scrolls to caret.

features.feature: Spelling: check now, while typing, learn, ignore, correct
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Spelling and Grammar
features.note: No grammar check, no Correct Spelling Automatically, no Show Spelling and Grammar panel.
features.wire: Add a "Correct Spelling Automatically" checked item applying spell.rs best guess on word end in type_into (main.rs:454); grammar is out of scope.

features.feature: Substitutions (smart quotes, dashes, links, text replacement, data detectors)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Substitutions; Preferences.nib: Smart quotes/dashes/links
features.wire: Add an Edit > Substitutions submenu with checked Smart Quotes / Smart Dashes; apply in type_into (main.rs:454) when typing quotes or "--"; persist in preferences.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Transformations
features.wire: Add three items in edit_menu that replace the selection with its transformed string through the text.rs undoable replace.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Speech > Start/Stop Speaking
features.wire: Start/Stop Speaking items calling the SDK speech service with the selection or document.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Bold, Italic, Underline
Edit.nib: Format > Font > Outline, Kern, Ligatures, Baseline
features.wire: Add strikethrough and super/subscript flags to the cell style in text.rs, RTF \strike \super \sub in rtf.rs, draw in view.rs; Format > Font items.

features.feature: Font family and size (Bigger/Smaller, Show Fonts)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Show Fonts, Bigger, Smaller
features.note: Fixed list of families (text::FAMILIES) and step sizes; no font panel with all system fonts.
features.wire: Replace the FAMILIES submenu with the SDK font panel (Cmd+T) listing installed fonts; store family name in cells.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Show Colours, Highlight
features.note: Fixed colour palette only; no background highlight.
features.wire: Add a highlight (background colour) attribute in text.rs with RTF \highlight/\cb; open SDK colour panel for custom colours.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Copy Style, Paste Style
features.wire: Store the caret style in the app on Copy Style; apply to the selection on Paste Style (format_menu).

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Text > Align Left/Centre/Justify/Right
Edit.nib: Format > Text > Spacing…
features.note: Preset line spacings only; no before/after paragraph spacing sheet.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > List…
features.note: Bullets and numbers only; no list styles/prefix/start number.
features.wire: Add a List… sheet choosing marker style and start number; extend ListKind in text.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Table…
features.wire: Large: table cell blocks in the text model and RTF \trowd; defer.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Text > Writing Direction
features.wire: Add a paragraph direction prop and right-aligned bidi layout in layout.rs; menu items under Text.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Allow Hyphenation
features.wire: Low priority; soft-hyphen breaking in layout.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Make Vertical Layout

features.apple: Edit.nib: View > Zoom In, Zoom Out, Actual Size

features.apple: SelectLinePanel.nib, LinePanel strings
features.wire: Add Edit > Find > Select Line… (cmd+L) sheet taking "n" or "n-m" and selecting those lines via text.rs line index.
